notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.3  更新

- The title screen text image has been updated.

- Added save data management during data selection on the title screen.

- Points for player characters now increase by 2 per level based on cumulative level.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.2  Update

- You can now view game techniques in the information window.

notes.title: The version displayed was not changing, so I fixed it.
notes.notes: The game version displayed on the title screen was not changing, so this has been fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
- Made the tutorial easier to understand.

- Changed so that the app can be started by pressing the "Restart" button once.

- Added a screen to display the update details.

- Added English copyright page.
